description: This file defines the AppendStream class within the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 implementation. The class implements a read-only stream decorator that concatenates multiple stream objects and allows reading from them sequentially. It includes methods for adding streams, reading data, seeking, and getting stream metadata.

classes.name: AppendStream
classes.description: A stream class that concatenates multiple readable streams into one, allowing sequential reading across the combined streams. It implements the StreamInterface and provides methods for managing the collection of streams, reading data, seeking within the combined stream, and obtaining metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AppendStream with an optional array of streams to be appended.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire contents of the combined streams as a string, rewinding before reading.

methods.name: addStream
methods.description: Adds a new stream to the append list after verifying it is readable. Updates the seekability status based on the stream.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the concatenated contents of all streams.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all attached streams and resets internal state.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches all streams, resets internal state, and returns null.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the concatenated stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of all streams, if known; returns null if any stream size is unknown.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the current stream position is at EOF for the appended streams.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream position to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Attempts to seek to a specified offset using SEEK_SET; only supports this whence.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified length from the current stream position, advancing the position accordingly.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Returns false, indicating the stream is not writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns whether the append stream is seekable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws an exception, as the stream is read-only.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata about the stream; returns null for a specific key or an empty array when called without arguments.
